questions.prompt: We write using ___. (a Stick, b Pen, c Book)
steps: A pen is a writing tool.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Cat is to kitten as dog is to ___. (a Cub, b Food, c Puppy)
steps: A kitten is a young cat; a puppy is a young dog.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The tea is ___ hot to drink. (a To, b Much, c Too)
steps: Too before an adjective means excessively.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Juma is ___ than Eunice. (a Tattles, b Tall, c Taller)
steps: Than requires the comparative form taller.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A person who mends clothes is a ___. (a Cobbler, b Trailor, c Tailor)
steps: A tailor makes or repairs clothes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She ___ coming to school. (a Are, b Is, c Have)
steps: She is singular and takes is.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We ___ eaten our lunch. (a Has, b Have, c Will)
steps: We have eaten is the present perfect.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Which word has the same ending sound as market? (a Jacket, b Batterry, c Rake)
steps: Market and jacket have a similar final unstressed syllable ending in /t/.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: One wolf, many ___. (a Wolds, b Wolves, c Wolfes)
steps: Wolf changes f to ves in the plural.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Signs used for the sounds of letters are ___. Word bank: Morning, Symbols, Phonemic, Zebra crossing.
steps: A phonemic symbol represents a speech sound. Use phonemic to distinguish these from general symbols.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Phonemic symbols (intended); the bank's phonemic alone is an incomplete noun phrase.

questions.prompt: The part of the day before noon is called ___.
steps: Morning comes before midday.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A place where pedestrians safely cross a road is a ___.
steps: The striped crossing is called a zebra crossing; look for traffic before crossing.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A sign of something is called a ___.
steps: A symbol represents an idea or thing; singular a requires symbol.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I have eaten ___ orange. (an, a, the)
steps: Orange begins with a vowel sound; an introduces one orange.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My mother has a dress. ___ dress is blue. (an, a, the)
steps: The refers back to the already mentioned dress.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: I spent ___ hour writing. (an, a, the)
steps: Hour begins with a vowel sound because h is silent.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Name the group: bananas, mangoes, cucumber, oranges.
steps: All develop as fruits botanically, while everyday food grouping treats cucumber differently.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: Fruits (botanically); cucumber is commonly called a vegetable in cooking.

questions.prompt: Name the group: yellow, green, blue, white.
steps: All four words name colours.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Name the group: table, bed, cupboard, chair.
steps: These are items of furniture.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Circle the noun: A pig was killed.
steps: Pig names an animal; was killed is the verb phrase.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Circle the noun: I was talking to Linda.
steps: Linda is a person's proper name; I is a pronoun.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The mother of your mother is your ___.
steps: A parent's mother is a grandmother.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: A person who sails in a ship is a ___.
steps: A sailor works or travels as part of a ship's crew.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Where is the school in the passage located?
steps: The opening says the school is located in Lindi.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What is the heading of the passage?
steps: Comprehension is a section label, not the story's title. A model title should not be treated as a printed one.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: No separate title is printed. Suggested title: Our School.

questions.prompt: What is the school called?
steps: The first sentence names it.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Which day is sports day?
steps: The passage says every Friday is a sports day.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
